f.title: Submit updated Local Safety Responsible (LSR) details to the Drug Safety Center by 12 March 2026
f.statement: All marketing authorisation holders, manufacturing companies and local agents are requested to submit an updated set of all details on their Local Safety Responsible (LSR) through the Ministry of Health online form by 12 March 2026, using the attached Excel template: MAH/company name, local agent, number of registered products and product list, LSR name, LSR contact number/email, and LSR PV training (2025/2026).
f.applicability: All MAHs, manufacturing companies and local agents with products in Oman

f.title: Appoint an Omani national as Local Safety Responsible
f.statement: The Local Safety Responsible (LSR) should be an Omani national, as required by Drug Safety Center circular no. 28/2019.
